title: Time limit for opinion
description: Time limit for giving opinion on referred points

content.general_rule: The opinion of the majority shall be the order of the District Commission
content.exception: The other member shall give his opinion on such point or points referred to him within a period of one month from the date of such reference
conditions: within a period of one month from the date of such reference
